purpose: Replace spatially leaking independent-primitive source OOF folds with deterministic groups derived only from the exact source-raster responsibility footprint.
claim_boundary: CPU authority construction and source-evidence fold preflight only; no benchmark adapter, target image, target mask, target metric, or GPU execution is part of this registration.

allowed: verified exact raster-responsibility COO pixel identifiers
verified exact raster-responsibility COO primitive identifiers

fixed_grid.pixel_assignment: row-major pixel center mapped into the fixed rectangular grid
fixed_grid.invisible: one sentinel group whose id equals the number of visible raster blocks

row_contract.primitive_identifier_domain: caller must explicitly declare local hierarchy indices or global primitive rows
row_contract.duplicate_semantics: a repeated exact pixel/primitive COO pair is malformed and rejected rather than silently summed
row_contract.triplet_permutation: canonical sorting makes all outputs and digests invariant to triplet input order

fold_contract.clear: positive_weight, negative_weight, raw_positive_mass, and raw_negative_mass are all set to exact zero for every primitive in every heldout group before compilation
fold_contract.minimum_population: every heldout fold must contain at least 32 observed positive rows and 32 observed negative rows; otherwise the method returns the field base without running hierarchy selection

authority.tamper_policy: unknown authority, row misalignment, invalid ranges, non-finite/non-positive weights, duplicates, and digest changes fail closed

required_tests: triplet permutation invariance and exact tie break
authority construction API has no label or mask input
same group always maps to the same fold
all four evidence tensors are cleared for the whole heldout group
class-degenerate fold returns the field base
synthetic exact-adjoint evidence composes with the authority
range, duplicate, alignment, SHA, and tensor tamper fail closed
